QuestInfo.name: The Eyes Glow
QuestInfo.0: #b#p502##k in #m10004000# is calling for me. Something has changed.
QuestInfo.1: The #b#t4000045#s#k by #b#p502##k's fire are glowing. He says the Balrog's guards are gathering at the Sanctuary Entrance. I need to defeat #r30 #o52#s#k and #r30 #o53#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the guards at the Sanctuary Entrance. #b#p502##k says the way to #m10005105# is open.

0.0: #h0#. Good, you came. Look at the eyes by the fire.
0.1: Last night they were dim. Tonight they burn red. Something in #m10005105# has woken up.
0.2: Before you can reach it, you have to get past its guards. Defeat #r30 #o52#s#k and #r30 #o53#s#k at the Sanctuary Entrance.

yes.0: Go through #m10005100#, past #m10005080#. The Sanctuary Entrance is beyond it. Don't go further than that. Not yet.

no.0: ...I understand. But the eyes won't stop glowing on their own.

1.0: You cleared the entrance? Then the way is open.
1.1: Take these. You'll need them for what comes next.

mob.0: The guards still stand. Defeat #r30 #o52#s#k and #r30 #o53#s#k at the Sanctuary Entrance.
